mentions.name: SearchCue
mentions.description: Site-search engine aimed at anyone with a site that wants to add search. It supports crawling and indexing of pages, most common office documents and PDFs, runs OCR and feature extraction on images, and offers typeahead search plus agentic/conversational AI search. It is built on a bespoke search stack around Tantivy (replacing Meilisearch), with search nodes distributed around the globe to keep latency low for end users anywhere.
mentions.source_excerpt: We are working on our two site-search search engines Monocle Search [0] and SearchCue [1]. The former is squarely aimed at people using Squarespace, whereas our newer offering SearchCue is aimed at anyone with a site that wants to add search.
mentions.author: probst
